registration_statement: Written and committed in its own commit before any Python-vs-Rust comparison of these functions (lane SC-WP-11, branch lane-wp11-assess). No Rust implementation exists at registration. The registration commit is recorded in the report.

lane.authority: A9.21 item 4 (ICP_GATE: fail closed, NOT_EVALUATED without accepted criteria and evidence); A9.6 sec. 15 (six RVM states); A9.31 sec. 12

reference_implementation.python_commit_note: origin/integration/simulation-complete at lane start; never the bid record

files.role: reference: RECORDER_PROPOSALS[RP-A919-01] text read by a9_21_icp_gate.proposal()
imported by a9_21_icp_gate (decision pins); not exercised by R7 / R8
context: rvm_gate_snapshot reads the same committed RVM (contract PARITY-C-ABEP_SIM_ASSESSMENT_DESIGN_GATES_PY-V1)

reference_implementation.rule: the campaign refuses to score (REFUSED_REFERENCE_CHANGED) if any reference file sha256 differs from sha256_at_registration

functions_or_entry_points: abep_assess::rvm::{STATUSES, ROLES, ARTIFACT_KINDS, RULES, validate_artifact, assign_status, is_not_applicable_cell, floor_fail_check, assert_status_vocabulary, assert_no_pass_without_measurement}
abep_assess::rvm::RvmRecord (the committed rvm_a9_v1.json, sha256-verified) with replay_cells / gng_icp_01
rust_implementation.rule: the report records the sha256 of every provenance source

governing_hashes.rule: a mismatch voids the run (INPUT_MISMATCH, not a verdict)

inputs.harness: scripts/rust_migration/parity_assess_v1.py (committed after this contract and before the scoring run)
inputs.transport: JSON; non-finite floats wrapped as {'float': 'NaN' | '+inf' | '-inf'}; R7 file citations point into a scratch directory the harness writes (registered files with known sha256) and are evaluated with root = that directory in both implementations

list_or_generator.GR-01: R1 the vocabularies and rule table
list_or_generator.GR-02: R6 every row x configuration cell of the committed RVM (30 rows x 2 configurations)
list_or_generator.GR-03: R5 both asserts on the committed RVM document
list_or_generator.GR-04: R8 evaluate(criteria, evidence) of the committed GNG-ICP-01 gate (criteria PENDING_OWNER_ACCEPTANCE, evidence []) and lock1_release_reportable([that gate])

edge_cases.inputs: R2 each ARTIFACT_FIELDS key missing; each wrong type (int for bool, bool for int, negative int, str for bool, float for int, list for str)

R2 synthetic true; measured on a non-measurement; MEASUREMENT not measured; evaluated non-evaluating kind; meets without evaluation; meets True on a budget; lower_bound_verified / exceeds_limit_every_reading on a non-budget; empty path / id; unknown role / kind
R3 requirement_frozen non-bool; no artifacts; NOT_APPLICABLE marker mixed with evidence; no DETERMINING artifact

R3 one vector per rule R1..R7 (numerical failure without measurement; measured violation; PASS frozen / not frozen; coverage incomplete; verified floor fail; all out of domain; evidenced partial; nothing evaluated)
R4 empty readings; NaN / inf / bool / str values; strict and non-strict limits; ties at the limit
R5 a document with a foreign status / a reordered vocabulary / a PASS cell with and without a verified measurement

R7 criteria not a dict / status not OWNER_ACCEPTED; criteria citing RP-A919-01 or 'recorder proposal'; an item without text; an item whose text is a substring of the proposal; owner decision without path / with a bad sha256 / with a sha256 that does not verify / outside root; empty / duplicate / missing ids; evidence missing, with a non-verifying source, with NOT_MET, all MET; non-dict evidence entries
R8 empty gate list; non-mandatory gates only; a gate without status

randomized_domain.draw: one generator per entry (campaign_seeds.derivation); R2 500, R3 1000, R4 400, R7 500, R8 200

distribution.R2/R3: 1-5 artifacts each; every field drawn from its admissible values (kind / role uniformly, booleans 0.5, in_domain / meets / exceeds_limit_every_reading from {True, False, None}, evidenced_terms 0-4), with consistency repairs drawn so that about half the artifacts validate; requirement_frozen random
distribution.R4: 1-6 readings of floor_only_kg U(0, 80) (some ints), limit 40 or U(0, 80), strict random
distribution.R7: criteria accepted / not, 1-4 items with random ids / texts (some proposal substrings), owner decision citations of registered scratch files (valid / tampered sha256 / outside root / missing), 0-6 evidence entries over the item ids with results MET / NOT_MET / other
distribution.R8: 0-5 gates with status from {GO, NO_GO, NOT_EVALUATED, absent} and mandatory from {True, False, absent, 0, 1}

campaign_seeds.derivation: rng_e = random.Random(master_seed * 1000 + e), e the entry index (R1..R8 -> 1..8); draws in the registered order; input values only

rng_stream_roles.other_streams: NOT_APPLICABLE: neither implementation draws random numbers

campaign_seeds.development_rule: development comparisons use development_master_seed only and are never scored; every scoring execution is appended to campaign_history and the report is committed whatever its verdict

all_entries.name: outcome, error class and message
all_entries.definition: RETURNED or RAISED; RvmError class and message equal; any other Python class (KeyError / TypeError on shapes outside the documented artifact / document records): outcome RAISED only (DIV-R02)

all_entries.name: returned value
all_entries.tolerance: equal (canonical JSON; tuples as lists; floats by bit pattern)
all_entries.definition: assign_status -> [status, rule_id, reason]; floor_fail_check dict; evaluate dict; booleans

tolerance_basis.registered: rules, comparisons and round(x, 6) (correctly rounded both sides)

exact_invariants.statement: assign_status never returns PASS unless a DETERMINING, verified, measured, in-domain MEASUREMENT meets and covers the requirement and requirement_frozen is True
the replay of every committed RVM cell reproduces its committed (status, rule, reason) exactly; GNG-ICP-01 replays to NOT_EVALUATED with its committed reason; lock1_release_reportable is False
evaluate never returns GO without an OWNER_ACCEPTED criteria record whose owner decision and every evidence source verify by sha256 under root
the recorder proposal text the Rust evaluator reads from the committed RVM equals a9_19_rvm.RECORDER_PROPOSALS[RP-A919-01]['proposal'] (harness check, DIV-R01)
double-run determinism of the Rust process

documented_divergences.statement: the reference reads the recorder proposal text from the module a9_19_rvm.RECORDER_PROPOSALS; Rust reads recorder_proposals_open_for_owner[id=RP-A919-01].proposal from the committed, sha256-pinned rvm_a9_v1.json (the same text: apply_rvm verifies equality when the RVM is built; INV-R-04 checks it)

inputs outside the documented record shapes (a non-dict cell, a readings entry without floor_only_kg, a criteria 'items' that is not a list) raise KeyError / TypeError in the reference; Rust refuses with MODEL_ERROR; outcome RAISED required, class not scored

path resolution: Python Path.resolve() (non-strict) vs Rust std::fs::canonicalize; a path that does not exist is not a file in both, so the result (False) is identical; registered cases only use regular files and directories without symlink loops

rules: six RVM states and the GO / NO_GO / NOT_EVALUATED gate vocabulary identical

captured_reference_outputs.sha256_manifest: reference_outputs/MANIFEST.json, written by the scoring run
captured_reference_outputs.purpose: CI replay after Python is retired

decision_rules.per_test: every scored observable of every vector is equal
decision_rules.verdict: ADMITTED iff every per-test, invariant, domain/error and schema check passes and every reference file matches sha256_at_registration; PARITY_PASS <=> ADMITTED
decision_rules.no_retuning: a failure is reported; any change is v2 with fresh scoring seeds

bid_boundary.statement: post-bid-freeze work; not citable by the bid package unless the owner re-freezes

what_this_is_not: not a regeneration of the RVM document
not an RVM status change: the committed statuses are replayed, never rewritten
not an approval of GO / NO-GO criteria (A9.21: none approved; GNG-ICP-01 stays NOT_EVALUATED)

value_status_preservation.check: committed RVM statuses are replayed exactly (INV-R-02)
